sources.entry: Directory Lister - Simple PHP based directory lister that lists a directory and all its sub-directories and allows you to navigate there within. (Source Code) MIT PHP/Docker

summary.one_liner: Directory Lister is a PHP web app that exposes the contents of a web-accessible folder, including subdirectories, as a browsable and shareable file listing.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a zero-configuration, drag-and-drop PHP application that lists a web-accessible folder and lets visitors navigate its subdirectories. Listed features include light and dark themes, custom sort ordering, file search, file hashes for verifying downloads, rendering of README files on directory pages, zip downloads of whole directories, and multi-lingual support. Configuration is done by copying .env.example to .env and editing values. Installation is by copying the files to a web server or using Docker Compose via a separate project the README links to.
use_cases: share files publicly over the web
browse a folder of downloads in a browser
expose a directory index on a web server
download an entire folder as a zip
host a public file mirror or archive
how_to_run: Copy extracted files/folders to your web server
notable: Built-in file hashes for download verification
Light and dark themes with multi-language support
caveats: Designed for public file sharing only; files in the configured path, including hidden files, are publicly accessible
Requires PHP 8.2 or newer with several extensions enabled
Zip downloads and README rendering depend on specific PHP extensions
